summary: Established a single durable deployment ownership/handoff contract inside the existing Portfolio control plane. The contract separates job ownership from Supabase mutation authority, pins non-secret source/Served identities, preserves verify_jwt=false as an explicit current behavior rather than an accidental default, requires pre-deploy rollback capture and post-deploy live readback, and forbids parallel deployment authority. No Supabase mutation occurred.

tests.name: single_existing_control_plane_owner
tests.evidence: Handoff remains a Portfolio job contract; no scheduler, queue, bridge or parallel authority was introduced.

tests.name: authority_separation
tests.evidence: Portfolio claim ownership and explicit Supabase mutation authorization are separate gates; GitHub-only write authority is insufficient.

tests.name: source_served_separation
tests.evidence: Candidate source blob and live Served version/digest are independently pinned and require post-deploy binding.

tests.name: secret_handling
tests.evidence: Contract references managed runtime bindings without reading or persisting secret values.

tests.name: rollback_evidence
tests.evidence: Future mutation requires a pre-deploy Served source snapshot/ref and the same authority gate for any rollback.

tests.name: no_deploy
tests.evidence: Only GitHub evidence/contract files were written; Supabase was read-only.
